map.name: Vurn
map.trouble: Vargoth, a renegade fire-mage, has stirred up the Imps and Ember Demons from the Deep Forge beneath Vurn, and the master smith Brannoc has sent the player to his old friend Kolbrin.

guard_bark.specifics: Durk, the guard at the Hall of Anvils, before and after the Helm of Far Sight is brought back.

again.speaker: Durk
again.text: Welcome to the Hall of Anvils. Master Kolbrin's workshop is at the back.

later.speaker: Durk
later.text: Word is you got the Helm back from those thieving Imps! Bless you, stranger!

bounty_offer.specifics: Grenna's coal cellar is overrun by Rats and her pig Gubbin is shut in with them.

offer.speaker: Grenna
offer.text:
Oh please, kind sir, help me! The Rats have overrun my coal cellar and my poor pig, Gubbin, is shut in down there with them!

Get rid of them and fetch him out and I'll owe you my life!

reminder.speaker: Grenna
reminder.text: Whatever you find down in the cellar is yours! Just hurry and save Gubbin!

completion.speaker: Grenna
completion.text:
Oh, thank heavens, you've got him! How will I ever pay you back for such courage?!

What's that, now? Heaps and heaps of gold? Well, if that's your price, here, accept this as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Save Gubbin the Pig from a Rat-infested cellar in Vurn.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Ambrel asks the player to bring back the Helm of Far Sight, carried off by Imps to the Cinder Caves.

offer.speaker: Ambrel
offer.text: Greetings, Wanderer! Thank the stars someone has come at last, for we badly need a strong arm. A band of Imps raided Vurn only days ago and made off with the Helm of Far Sight! Will you go to the Cinder Caves in the southwest and bring the precious relic back to me?

refusal.speaker: Ambrel
refusal.text: Alas! Then I fear the Helm is lost to us. Come back if you change your mind.

reminder.speaker: Ambrel
reminder.text: Quickly, bring back the Helm! Do not delay! For if he ever lays hands on it, Vargoth will put the Helm to the vilest of uses, indeed!

completion.speaker: Ambrel
completion.text:
Congratulations! My heartfelt thanks for bringing back the Helm! With it back in our hands, we will at last see through that wicked fire-mage's schemes!

Here, these Mana potions and this Ankh will serve you well... perhaps sooner than you'd like.

after.speaker: Ambrel
after.text: Thanks once more for everything you've done.

journal.text: Recover the Helm of Far Sight from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover the Helm of Far Sight from the Imps.

rumour.specifics: Pibble takes the player for a new smith, Brog's furnace is out again, Lissa rails against the traders of Tarvel.

rumour1.speaker: Pibble
rumour1.text: So you've come to join the smiths! Welcome to the guild! As makers of the town's steel, we carry a heavy load. I trust you'll do us proud at the anvil.

rumour2.speaker: Brog
rumour2.text: Well, there's the furnace gone out again. Can't forge, might as well go take a nap.

rumour3.speaker: Lissa
rumour3.text: The traders of Tarvel are a greedy and crooked pack of swindlers! Worst of all is that fat cheat, Grisold!

shop_greeting.specifics: Marga at the inn, Torbek the armorer, Zelphine the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Marga
inn.text: Sorry, I only pour for master smiths.

arms.speaker: Torbek
arms.text: Get out, you THIEF! Or I'll fetch the guards!

magic.speaker: Zelphine
magic.text: Adventurers always get a fair price at my shop. What would you like to see?

two_givers.specifics: Kragg the armorer sells a chain tunic fitting for 100 gold, Pibble wants his furnace chain pulled on his signal.

offer_a.speaker: Kragg
offer_a.text: Ready to be fitted for a chain tunic? I'll want 100 gold for the iron.

offer_b.speaker: Pibble
offer_b.text:
Hey, you there. Could you yank that iron chain by the furnace when I wave my cap? I'd be ever so grateful.

Hold on, let me get out of the way first.

outcome_a.speaker: Kragg
outcome_a.text: Hmmm, a shame. Not everyone can afford proper armor.

outcome_b.speaker: Pibble
outcome_b.text: It roared! I can't believe it roared! Thank you! You're my lucky charm!

journal_a.text: Buy a chain tunic from Kragg the armorer.

journal_b.text: Pull Pibble's furnace chain when he gives the signal.

rescue.specifics: Guildmaster Orsk's daughter Nessa is trapped in the bell tower by Bats.

plea.speaker: Orsk
plea.text:
These blasted Bats are a curse on my house! My men tried to smoke them out, but they return every night! Only you can get past them now and bring my daughter Nessa home!

She is up in the bell tower, there, past the iron door. Please, take care.

reminder.speaker: Orsk
reminder.text: I shall not rest till my Nessa is safe! Fight past those Bats! And bring her down! Hurry, before more of them come!

found.speaker: Nessa
found.text: Oh! You came for me! Please, get me out of this tower!

following.speaker: Nessa
following.text: Quickly, before the Bats come back!

completion.speaker: Orsk
completion.text:
Kind sir, you have my undying thanks! You are a true hero of this town. I will tell the gatemen that you may pass through the Ash Gate whenever you wish.

Take this purse as a reward for your trouble. I insist.

journal.text: Rescue Guildmaster Orsk's daughter from the bell tower.

main_opening.specifics: Brog points to Kolbrin, who sends the player into the Deep Forge to learn if Vargoth is below.

opening.speaker: Kolbrin
opening.text: The way down to the Deep Forge is through the old smelter at the top of the hill. Find out if Vargoth's been down there. You'll see. And watch yourself. Many of the lower halls have pits to catch thieves.

reminder.speaker: Kolbrin
reminder.text: Get down into the Deep Forge, lad! We have to learn if the stories about Vargoth are true. Go! Search the lower halls and see if he has already been there.

journal.text: Search the Deep Forge for any sign of Vargoth.
